crypto_published_justification: Worker WebCrypto generates independent 256-bit capabilities with crypto.getRandomValues and hashes them with SHA-256 before session storage. The implementation is available through FLOSS workerd/Miniflare. Cloudflare supplies TLS; operator deployment policy must preserve HTTPS and TLS >=1.2. Short human-entry codes have expiry and an eight-attempt lockout and are not encryption keys. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-swop/blob/main/docs/security-design.md

crypto_keylength_justification: The documented supported strict profile uses RSA >=2048 or ECDSA P-256/P-384 edge certificates, TLS >=1.2 with modern AEAD suites, and VPORTAL_ENDPOINTS_JSON=[] to disable all unverified outgoing relay TLS. A real workerd regression proves both HTTP and HTTPS relay requests make no outbound fetch. The core sessions use 256-bit WebCrypto capabilities and SHA-256. This is a configurable profile, not a claim about an existing hosted deployment. https://github.com/open-ott-play/ottplay-swop/blob/main/docs/security-design.md
